ego/noisy.pairing: Same case/regime, source identity, seed, model and full input SHA; both scene outputs committed.

exo/noisy.pairing: Same case/regime, source identity, seed, model and full input SHA; both scene outputs committed.

combined_modes/noisy.pairing: Same case/regime, source identity, seed, model and full input SHA; both scene outputs committed.

aggregation.window_weighted_mean: Every valid window has weight one; datasets are weighted by their completed valid-window counts.
aggregation.dataset_macro_mean: Equal weight per planned dataset, using each dataset's valid-window mean; null when any planned dataset lacks a valid value.
aggregation.partial: Incomplete coverage stays partial even when every dataset has at least one value.
aggregation.combined_modes: Optional heterogeneous-input descriptive aggregate; EGO and EXO remain separately reported and are not interchangeable protocols.

disclosure: Native192/30Hz/S64,22 common joints,known body profile,synthetic/noisy sensor observations,observed static recording union; not a matched AMASS-only paper protocol.

source_SUMMARY.note: May lag the committed rows snapshot; all new aggregates are computed from rows.

CPU_saved_metric_recomputation.scope: Exact CPU reproduction of saved metrics/counts and ON/OFF arrays; separate from the independent NumPy gate.

original_CUDA_inputs.scope: Original singleton CUDA input/reference reconstruction only; no new motion prediction.

foot_threshold_boundary_diagnostic.interpretation: GT foot velocities near0.2 m/s may cross the hard threshold under independent FK precision, changing the selected sample and denominator. The original metric/denominator is reproduced; this diagnoses the independent-check failure without changing the registered tolerance or metric.
